paragraphs: MTW Solutions sells software products and information technology services to state government agencies in the United States. Those products are configurable commercial off-the-shelf software that the company says is in use by state agencies across the United States.

The product line targets three core areas: grant management, unemployment insurance tax audit, and child nutrition management. The Grant Management System supports allocation of funds, application, budgeting, review and approval, payments, reporting and closeout. COMPAS UI Tax Audit gives Unemployment Insurance Tax Auditors software tools to complete audits based on TPS guidelines. COMPAS - BAM is built on the same framework and is used to complete Benefit Accuracy Measurement investigations. Harvest is a child nutrition management system for state government agencies.

Named customers on the grant system page include the Illinois State Board of Education, the Montana Office of Public Instruction and the Vermont Agency of Education. The about page names the Alaska Department of Labor and Workforce Development as an early COMPAS customer.

quote.text: MTW Solutions provides specialized software products and information technology services to state government agencies in the United States.
